name: unity
description: Role-based development flow for Claude Code (design -> build -> review, plus a manual /unity:test) on GitHub issues and Projects. Design with the developer, then build and review as separate agents in fresh contexts, run in one go by /unity:ship, with GitHub as the only handoff: test-first build and independent review. /unity:test tests the whole project when the developer chooses and files what it finds as stories.
